quick.heading: Write it once, let the AI do the rest
quick.subheading: Type everything you know about the brand and the campaign. The AI extracts the structure and picks the experience goal and customer journey for you.
quick.title: Report name
quick.titlePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the first line of the brief
quick.briefPlaceholder:
e.g. Happy City Ca Mau — the first model township in Ca Mau...

Worth mentioning: brand and positioning, product/service, target audience and their pain points, campaign objective, competitors and market, current challenges.

Write naturally, no particular order needed.
quick.autoNote: The AI will pick the experience goal and customer journey
quick.imageHint: optional — you can paste several at once
quick.imagePlaceholder:
https://…/photo-1.jpg
https://…/photo-2.jpg
or paste them all, comma-separated
quick.imageRejected: Skipped {n} entries that are not http(s) links
quick.imageMultiHint: Paste several links at once — one per line, or comma-separated. ⌘/Ctrl + Enter to add.

variant.heading: Create a landing from an existing template
variant.subheading: Pick an existing landing as the frame — AI rewrites ALL of its content from your brief and images. The source page is untouched.
variant.templateHint: only landings that have a canvas
variant.noPages: This workspace has no landing pages yet
variant.name: New page name
variant.detailsHint: the more specific, the less you fix by hand later
variant.detailsPlaceholder: e.g. Evermore NDINO318LDIA engagement ring, 7x11mm pear-cut diamond. 73,837,360₫ (8% off 80,258,000₫). 0% instalments, lifetime warranty, free exchange within 72h.
variant.objectivePlaceholder: e.g. Collect showroom appointment leads, lean into the proposal moment.
variant.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. Men 27–38 in Hanoi and HCMC, budget 60–100M₫.
variant.mediaHint: AI may only pick from this list — it cannot invent URLs
variant.publishHint: Publish straight to the public /p/… page
variant.pickFirst: Pick a landing to use as the frame
variant.runNote: AI writes copy for every block — takes 1–3 minutes. No page is created at this step.
variant.dontClose: Don't close this tab — closing midway still burns tokens without producing a page.

stage.page: Building the page from the frame
stage.overrides: Applying the fields you filled in

variant.blockNoFieldsHint: This block has no editable text or image field — AI skips it too, so it keeps the frame's content.

variant.contentSummaryValue: {blocks} blocks written by AI · {kept} fields kept as you typed

variant.errNotFound: Landing not found, or it doesn't belong to your brand.
variant.errGeneric: Creating the landing failed. Try again or pick another landing.

variant.preview: Open the real page in a new tab
